dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A bit is about right. And you?

dialogues.speaker: Rahman
dialogues.text: Hah, well, I've actually gotten busier recently. Other than completing the work that Cyno has assigned to us, I still have my lady's protection to worry about.

dialogues.speaker: Rahman
dialogues.text: By "my lady," I mean Ms. Setaria, whom I'm sure you know. She left the Akademiya recently — with permission, of course.

dialogues.speaker: Rahman
dialogues.text: She wants to pass on the things she knows to the desert people. Both Lesser Lord Kusanali and Cyno have approved of this plan, and they've both helped quite a bit, too.

dialogues.speaker: Rahman
dialogues.text: Ah, this is a blessing that is hard to come by, especially for us, the children of King Deshret. We must hold it most dear indeed.
